{{Kombat Navbox}} {{Infobox league |name=Kombat Duel #8 |tickername=Duel Kombat |image=Kombato3.jpg |icon=Kombato3.jpg |admin={{player|alice|flag=se}} |mode=1on1 |format=Single-Elimination |prizepool= |tournaments=1on1 |entrance= |website=discord.gg/2qkVVan724 |sdate=Every saturday |year=2025 |twitch=peppe_qw |map1=axe |map2=thor |map3=elektrarnarc17z }} '''Kombat Weekly''' is an arena for new duel maps. The intention is to make it easier to enjoy new maps without requiring the map to be completely finished, they can very well be unpolished beta versions of a map that needs to be tested and played! The intention of this is meant to favor both players and map-makers, to not force players into "map-testing" new maps in major leagues! As well as making the threshold lower for map-makers to not need a perfectly finished map to release for getting it tested. The purpose is to make it easier to keep standard Kombat events more concentrated on a mix with old maps while keep an expected high quality for the occasional new maps added into the mix. * '''Kombat Weekly''' will be played '''every Saturday sat 20.00 CET''' (21.00 for high div). * There will be 3 maps per week. ** Rotation of maps will change more or less, some maps might stick around for more testing. New versions might alternate. == Format == * Higher division start 21.00 CET * Lower division start 20.00 CET ** The 2 top players from lower proceed to higher. * '''Single elimination playoffs''' * "/1on1" | To add match tag type "/1on1 Kombat" * Pause rules: Each player is allowed one pause per match, once you have used a pause and use it again, you have forfeited the map. * Ping rules: This is an international tournament, meaning that when players from Europe or North America face off a suitable should be used. Find a server that keeps both players around the same ping +/- 13ms, if no such server can be found, the lowest ping player will have to use cl_delay_packet to get closer to the higher ping player. If there's a dispute in what server should be used, contact admin in discord. * Client: ezQuake 3.6.x. For your own sake, update your client! * Ruleset: smackdown/qcon ** Remember to check with f_ruleset * Walkovers will be given by admin when 20+ minutes of waiting has passed. * Reporting: send screenshots in [http://discord.quake.world/ discord] channel: #kombat.
